mutations.name: the approval gates on not-failure instead of success
kills: approveOnSuccess a MERGE held because auto-merge is armed posts no approval and records nothing

mutations.name: a replay posts again instead of reusing its approval
kills: approveOnSuccess a replay after a crash finds its approval at the head and posts no second one

mutations.name: a person's review carrying the marker counts as Shepherd's
kills: approveOnSuccess a person's approval at the head without the marker does not stop Shepherd's own approval

mutations.name: a missing App records nothing
mutations.find: if (!port) return { reviewError: "no shepherd.reviewCheck App is configured" };
kills: approveOnSuccess with no App configured a success records the missing App instead of approving

mutations.name: a failed review post fails the step
kills: approveOnSuccess a rejected review post is recorded by HTTP status only and never throws

mutations.name: the approval body drops the check title naming the carry rule
kills: approveOnSuccess a MERGE carried from an older reviewed head is approved at the PR's head, not the head the verdict named

mutations.name: the step result drops the review
kills: sh-publish-review carries the check run URL in the step output when published

mutations.name: the step never approves
mutations.find: const review = await approveOnSuccess(port, input, check);
kills: sh-publish-review a MERGE at the head approves the PR at that head under the App, beside the success check
